summary:
Main
Iron ore futures retreated after early gains today, while most Qingdao port spot products, seaborne quotes and the domestic ore compositeindex weakened in tandem. DCE most-traded closed at 659.5 yuan/mt, down 0.53% from Nov 26. Six of the eight Qingdao spot products declined while two held flat: PB Fines, Newman Fines, Newman Lump, SSF, Carajas Fines and PB Lump each fell 3 yuan/wmt, whereas Mac Fines (638) and BRBF (688 yuan/wmt) were unchanged.
